name: bl-supply-off
summary: Switch the backlight supply (0x44B bit 3) off with every panel-off and on at every panel-on; removes the standby glow
status: hardware-tested 2026-10-04 (one monitor): supply off in link-held standby (0x44B = 0x02), backlight back on wake without firmware restart

edits.asm: off_tail / on_entry (linker padding 0x203940): clear / set 0x44B bit 3 (backlight supply)
sub_245860 epilogue (lwz r9 + 1st byte of addi) -> j off_tail; the rest is never reached
sub_245919 prologue (addi r1,-8 + 2 bytes of sw r9) -> j on_entry; continues at 0x24591E

notes: The vendor panel-off only drops the backlight enable; the LED supply stays on and the LEDs glow faintly in link-held standby. 0x44B bit 3 switches that supply (the vendor clears it only for deep standby). Panel-off clears it after VLCD off; panel-on sets it before VLCD on, about 600 ms before the backlight enable. Generated by tools/patches_src_bl_supply.py. Known limitation (hardware-tested 2026-10-04): after the supply was off, a single panel-on without video from the source leaves the backlight dark (LED white). A menu key press in link-held standby therefore wakes the monitor with a dark panel; the OSD becomes visible once the source sends video (or after a power-key off/on). Plasma/source wake is not affected. Register dumps of the stuck and working states showed no readable difference; input switching does not recover it.
